images.prompt: Use case stylized-concept. A project-bound concept image for a lighthearted approachable fantasy side-view pixel-art timing combat game, landscape 16:9. Show FIVE equal vertical panels, clear thin cream separators, each distinct environment seen SIDE ON with a broad FLAT horizontal walkable ground at 68% height. Panel1 warm meadow outskirts: rolling mint green hills, simple timber farmhouse, small supply cart, tan path, clear sky. Panel2 leafy woodland: giant simple green tree trunks at outer edges, rope lookout platform, yellow-green light, simple fallen log, forest trail. Panel3 dwarf quarry and ancient mine: cream limestone arches, warm amber ore, timber mine braces, turquoise rune on squared stone doorway, clear dry flagstone path, not dark/grim. Panel4 breezy highlands: turquoise distant peaks, pale clouds, windblown grass, little wooden rope bridge at right edge, rocky flat ledge. Panel5 red dragon's mountaintop lair: sunny warm terracotta rock pillars, airy blue sky, some wooden supply crates and gold coins near back, a distant red dragon silhouette curled on an upper rock off the walkable strip. Cheerful adventurous fantasy, dignified and warm, not a baby game. EXTREMELY simple chunky low-resolution pixel art, 320x180 apparent large pixels enlarged, 16-24 flat colors total, hard stepped edges, large silhouette blocks, no microtexture, no gradients, no painterly rendering. Atmospheric far layers use muted teal-green; warm golden player contrast reserved. NO churches, bells, bell towers, religious iconography, festivals, bunting, text, names, numbers, logos, UI, characters in foreground. NOT a top-down map; five side-on environment studies in one clean composition. Ground height aligned across all panels, broad uncluttered central combat lanes.

images.prompt: Use case stylized-concept. Center x25–80%, y30–65% is uncluttered muted midvalue mint for combat readability. Bright adventurous countryside with broad reassuring shapes, not dark gothic, not infantilized. Background only: NO characters, no monsters, NO weapons, NO text, NO UI, NO bells, no bell shapes, no church or towers, no festivals or bunting.
